The Primary Desk in the Home Office. One clear surface for the work you are actually doing right now.

What done looks like:
1. Mouse in fixed positions
2. One inbox tray holding fewer than a dozen sheets
3. No sticky notes on the monitor bezel
4. The power strip hooked off the floor so the chair rolls over bare carpet
